description: Multi-agent orchestrator with tiered API-key routing (supervisor/workers on high/mid/low tiers), built on LangGraph.
container.title: Orchestrator
configuration.title: LangGraph Orchestrator
configuration.tiers: Tier assignment rules for API keys. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins. Fields: match (substring for name/baseUrl/model), priorityFrom/priorityTo (team priority range 0-1000), tier (high|mid|low).
configuration.tierOverrides: Manual tier overrides per key id (key id -> high|mid|low). Set from the Orchestrator panel.
configuration.approvals: Tool approval policy: auto-readonly (read tools only), confirm-writes (writes and terminal need approval), confirm-all (every tool call needs approval).
configuration.maxParallelWorkers: Maximum number of worker agents running in parallel (Send fan-out limit).
configuration.maxAgentsPerKey: How many agents may call a model through one key at the same time (0 = no limit). A soft limit: if every key of the tier is full, the task still runs.
configuration.uiLanguage: Panel language: auto (default — the Aura language switch, then the IDE), ru or en.
configuration.escalationThreshold: How many times a task may fail on a lower tier before the node is escalated to a higher tier key.
configuration.terminalAllowlist: Terminal command prefixes agents may run without extra confirmation.
configuration.maxVerifyRetries: How many times a failed subtask is re-run automatically after verification failure before giving up (evaluator-optimizer loop).
configuration.verifyCommand: Shell command the verify node runs after a failed batch (e.g. npm test). Its output is fed to the retrying worker as the actual failure context. Empty keeps the text-heuristic only.
configuration.gitPath: Path to the git binary used for worker worktree isolation and merge. Defaults to git on PATH.
configuration.checks: Project check commands the self-healing loop runs inside a worker worktree, in order (lint, typecheck, test). Each item: {command, timeoutMs}. Empty falls back to npm run lint / npx tsc --noEmit / npm test.
configuration.maxFixIterations: Hard limit of edit → check iterations inside a worker. After this many failed attempts the node becomes needs_human and the graph raises an interrupt.
configuration.budget: Token and USD budget for a run and for each node (0 disables a limit) plus model prices per 1M tokens. Unknown models are priced as the high tier.
configuration.trace: OpenTelemetry-style tracing of nodes and LLM calls: enable spans, optionally append JSONL to .aura/orchestrator/traces, and set an OTLP/HTTP endpoint to export to.
configuration.teamAutoGrab: Automatically pick up Aura Team board tasks from To do that carry the [agent] label in the title and hand them to the multi-agent team.
configuration.teamAutoGrabLimit: How many [agent] tasks the auto-grab keeps in the queue. The orchestrator still works through them one at a time.
tool.team.userDescription: Delegate the task to the multi-agent team (supervisor plus coder, tester, security auditor and reviewer).
tool.team.modelDescription: Delegate a multi-file task to a team of agents that works autonomously: a supervisor plans the work, worker agents (coder, tester, security-auditor, reviewer) execute it in parallel on the team's API keys, and the caller gets a report. Progress is visible while it runs. Payload: {"task": string, "max_workers"?: number}. Use it for tasks that change several files and need tests or review; for a single-file edit call the file tools directly.
